title: Quarterly cadence: Cohort-driven capacity hedging & model lifecycle plan for Hosted API
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Define a capacity-aware quarterly roadmap for Hosted API that ties model catalog changes to customer cohort commitments and OKRs. Deliverables: (1) cohort segmentation and expected throughput per cohort, (2) model onboarding/retirement windows with rollback triggers, (3) capacity hedging policy (reserved vs burst buckets) and cost guardrails, (4) cross-team rollout calendar (PM/Eng/DevEx/Support), and (5) telemetry & OKR metrics (latency P95, cost per 1M tokens, model error/regression rate). Rationale: Recent variability in user behavior during regional promotions and model swaps exposed gaps between catalog change cadence and capacity planning. This ticket produces a repeatable cadence that minimizes outages, limits surprise costs, and provides clear signals for canary/rollbacks when quality regressions occur.
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting with Eng infra, Runtime, and DevEx. Agreed to use three customer cohorts (Free, Growth, Enterprise) mapped to capacity lanes.
2026-03-04: Draft cohort throughput assumptions created from Q1 telemetry. Early finding: Enterprise cohort has 4x burst spikes during business hours, requiring minimum reserved capacity.

2026-03-06: Trade-off discussion: aggressive model rotation reduces tail cost but increases regression risk. PM proposed a 2-week canary for model swaps for Growth cohort and 4-week canary for Enterprise.
2026-03-08: Design reviewed the proposed model lifecycle windows and requested clearer rollback criteria tied to eval sets and synthetic traffic harnesses.
2026-03-10: Added dependency on ENG-5023 (canary orchestration hooks). Preparing PRD for stakeholder review next week. Assigned follow-ups to Support for runbook updates.
